notes.title: Hotel Architect Launches into Steam Early Access Today!
notes.content:
Hello Tin Soldiers!

Today we are celebrating the launch of Hotel Architect as it heads into Early Access! Developed by our friends over at Pathos Interactive, Hotel Architect is the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game. 

Check out the Hotel Architect | Early Access Launch Trailer here: 
[previewyoutube=CT0FS38zxmc;full][/previewyoutube]

But that's not all - we have also joined forces in "[b]The Cozy Bundle[/b]" which offers a 25% discount! 

The Cozy Bundle Includes:
[list]
[*]Lumote: The Mastermote Chronicles
[*]Hotel Architect
[*]Tin Hearts
[/list]

[b]Check out The Cozy Bundle here: [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54031/The_Cozy_Bundle/

[b]About Hotel Architect[/b]

Step into the chaotic 24/7 lifestyle of a hotel owner as you design and build grand hotels across the globe. Juggle the increasingly elaborate demands of disorderly guests, logistical nightmares and unexpected obstacles in Hotel Architect, the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game.

Demonstrate your creative freedom as you build your hotel from the ground up taking your initial steps into the hospitality industry. In the career campaign or the sandbox mode, rejuvenate a rundown building or transform an empty plot into a hotel that towers above the Empire State Building, then design and dress a lobby that would be the envy of patrons at ‘The Ritz’.

Add a personal touch to your hotel with a range of decoration and furnishings tailored to the needs of your guests. Explore limitless design combinations across multiple floors with numerous zones and amenities available to construct within your hotel. So, if you feel that your Sauna is missing a Bar – simply build one around your guests!

In a fast-paced and frantic hotel, you will need to appease the harshest of critics, satisfy the needs of a variety of guests, and control the logistical chain full of unexpected obstacles, in order to achieve an illustrious 5-star rating. With a variety of staff whose attributes will be put to the test, you must ensure you’ve hired the right people for the job whilst managing your finances. Will you prioritize a world class chef at the expense of a clumsy receptionist? The choice is yours!

Hotel Architect is available now with a 2 week time-limited launch discount, priced at £12.79 / $15.99 / €15.99! 

[b]Check-in is available now! [/b]

notes.title: DIG VR Digs Deeper – Now Available on PS VR2 and SteamVR!
notes.content:
Grab your hard hat and hi-vis jacket – DIG VR is officially breaking ground on PS VR2 and Steam VR! Already a hit on Meta Quest, this true-to-life excavator simulation game is now ready to deliver the immersive experience of heavy-duty machinery to even more VR platforms.

Whether you're a construction enthusiast, a sim lover, or just want to experience the strangely satisfying thrill of digging through dirt with powerful machines, DIG VR is your ticket to a rugged virtual playground.

You can grab DIG VR in the 'DIG VR x Tin Hearts' Bundle right now - at a discounted price! 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50266/DIG_VR_x_Tin_Hearts_Bundle/

Watch the Launch Trailer and step into the muddy boots of a pro excavator in the charmingly gritty world of Diglington, Digshire.

[previewyoutube=DMGmtUMLkeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is DIG VR?[/h2]
DIG VR isn’t just another simulator – it’s a full-on excavation adventure. You’ll start out modestly, behind the controls of a mini-digger on your family’s farm, and work your way up to handling massive, high-powered machinery designed to take on the toughest terrain and trickiest jobs.

Whether you're mastering precision digging or powering through large-scale construction sites, DIG VR blends authenticity and fun in a way that's both challenging and deeply satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/06aaa89de2bf36118b20e97eed0a8a0a67014ed0.png[/img]

[h2]Features That Make DIG VR Stand Out:[/h2]
🔧 Authentic VR Simulation:
Choose between simplified and realistic control schemes to match your playstyle.

🚧 Career Mode:
Work your way from small jobs to becoming a seasoned machine operator in a full career campaign tailored for both casual players and serious sim fans.

🚜 Heavy Machinery Variety:
Control up to four different machines in various sizes, each designed for specific excavation needs.

🛠️ Unlock & Customize Tools:
Equip up to seven unique tool heads, including the Bucket, Breaker, Circular Saw, Auger, Trimmer, Compactor, and Grabber – and customize your digger with over 70 cosmetic upgrades like decals, paint jobs, and skins.

[h2]Available Now![/h2]
DIG VR is now out on PS VR2, and Steam VR, priced at £15.99 / $19.99 / €19.99 with 20% of for the first 2 weeks!  No matter where you dig, you're in for an authentic and immersive digging adventure!

notes.title: The Hotel Architect Demo is now live!
notes.content:
The wait is over! Our demo is now available as part of Steam Next Fest. This is your chance to step into the shoes of a hotelier and design the ultimate guest experience. Whether you've been eagerly following the game's development or are just discovering it, the demo offers a hands-on preview of what it takes to build, manage, and customize a world-class hotel.  

For those new here: What is Hotel Architect & What should you expect in the Demo?  

Hotel Architect is a detailed hotel management simulation that allows you to craft unique and luxurious accommodations (or not... Your choice!). Juggle the increasingly elaborate demands of disorderly guests, logistical nightmares and unexpected obstacles in the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game.  

In this demo, you can explore two stunning destinations: the bustling city of Gothenburg and the sun-soaked shores of Santorini. Each location presents unique challenges and opportunities, encouraging you to think strategically as you design and manage your properties.  

[b]Key features of the demo include: [/b] 

[list] 

[*] Scenario and Sandbox Modes - Tackle structured objectives or unleash your creativity in open-ended play.  

[*] Customizable Hotel Designs - Design every aspect of your hotel, from room layouts to décor  

[*] Diverse Guest Types - Cater to different guest profiles, each with unique needs and expectations. 

[*] Operational Challenges - Manage staffing, amenities, and services to keep guests happy and your business thriving.  

[/list]

notes.title: Dig VR is coming to Steam VR!
notes.content:
Hold on to your hard hats, VR explorers! Our publisher, Wired Productions are telling us It's time to dig deep because DIG VR is making its way to Steam VR on March 20th!

Dig VR received critical acclaim on the Meta Quest, for it's sim-light gameplay, charming sense of humour and stunning soundtrack. So you better get ready as we’re excited to announce that you will soon be experiencing the thrill of digging, discovering, and, most importantly, getting a little dirty!

[previewyoutube=wxCaReZIXeU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What you can expect from Dig VR:[/h2]
Capturing the sheer joy, adrenaline and frustrations of life on a digger, DIG VR is an exciting experience for both novices and pros. Starting with nothing more than a mini-digger and a dream, players will work up to earning the keys to a colossal excavating machine with a diverse set of attachments to overcome the most challenging of jobs. Dig, delve, dredge, and discover the love of all things excavational in DIG VR!
[list]
[*] Choice of authentic & simplified controller schemes
[*] Full Career Mode Campaign with options for both serious & casual players
[*] Control powerful machinery, with up to 4 machines in a range of sizes
[*] Unlock up to 7 unique tool heads to attach to the digger. Which includes a bucket, Breaker, Circular Saw, Auger, Trimmer, Compactor and Grabber.
[*] Over 70 customisation options to unlock for your digger, including decal, paint & skins
[*] Play quirky mini-games, or enjoy the zen sandbox mode
[*] Featuring the first ever dynamic dig-able terrain in VR that can be dug, moved and dumped.
[/list]
[h2]So, are you ready to dig?[/h2]
DIG VR will be available on March 20th, so make sure to mark that date on your calendar, set a reminder, or let’s be honest, start digging out your virtual hard hat now. Don't forget you can wishlist as well! 
It’s going to be a groundbreaking (see what we did there!) release, and we can’t wait to see all of you join in on the digging fun!

notes.title: Tin Hearts Patch
notes.content:
Hello Tin Soldiers!

We have a delightful little patch dropping today. It has plenty of minor bug fixes and more.

The full list is below:

• Fixed a game-breaking issue in level 44 - Powerglove, now (always) with actual power!
• Several improvements and bug fixes in level 44 - Yes, we even fixed THAT bug. Oh, and it’s prettier too.
• Second Vac Tube in level 42 should no longer NOPE soldiers incorrectly.
• Albert should no longer get pinned between the trio of Cannons in level 37.
• Albert should no longer manifest as a ghost before he has finished ‘moving on.
• No more frozen soldier between block and paint cans in Level 7.
• The Tin Hearts logo sometimes would overstay its welcome in the Study level.
• Level 44 lighting improved.
• The powerglove reveal cutscene has been polished.
• Albert insisted climbing on non existent objects in Act 4 (I mean we know you’re a ghost and all that Albert, but c’mon).
• Jumping to Mr Soldier works as expected even when you have multiple Mr Soldiers (like in Level 44).
• Removed the superglue from the lift buttons in Level 44 so now Albert’s hand won’t stick to them after pressing.
• Elevated the zapper generator that was previously on the floor in Level 44. It was unhygienic (but it’s now also easier to spot).
• We discovered some invisible walls inside some of the stampers in Level 44? Possibly an attempt by the soldiers to stop them stamping? Sorry soldiers, can’t allow that.
• It is now more intuitive to route your soldiers to the first ladder in Level 44.
• Some spiders in Level 44 were not meeting The Guild of Toymakers’s quality bar for lethality. These spiders have been terminated and replaced with appropriately lethal ones.
• The puzzle in the middle level of Level 44 has been streamlined.
• Albert’s night vision goggles project is needed no more. Lack of adequate lighting in some level 44 areas has been addressed.
• Ghost airships when blowing them with pinwheels have been politely asked to behave a bit more predictably from now on.
• Loads of other minor bug fixes!

notes.title: Tin Hearts: Features & Mechanics
notes.content:
In the lead-up to the launch of Tin Hearts, we wanted to take a deep dive into the features and mechanics of this narrative puzzle adventure! Come and take a peak behind the curtain.

[h3]Embark on a trail of puzzles [/h3]
Solve increasingly elaborate puzzles by controlling toy cannons to clear the way ahead, bouncing to new heights using trampoline drums, and manipulating balloon-inflating machines! With a variety of ways to solve the puzzles, there are always new and imaginative ways to help your soldiers reach their destination! Link objects in interesting ways as you build paths to the exit for your fearless tin soldiers to follow, and slowly reveal the secrets of their past.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/4f0613deff8686565910a22efa03956162ebeb81.png[/img]

[h3]Unravel the Story[/h3]
Tin Hearts takes you through the life and journey of Albert J. Butterworth, a genius inventor and toy maker in Victorian times. Told through the subtle clues in the environment and immersive cutscenes, Tin Hearts weaves all of this into the fabric of the puzzle-filled world of the Butterworth family’s home. 

Clues are everywhere, seek them out and you will be rewarded with a heartfelt tale! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/6f34d1c33599d432e30b01f2c603f51d3bd6427f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Explore a magical world [/h3]
Full of nostalgic warmth and charm, Tin Hearts makes you feel like a child in a toy store. Fully immersive, Tin Hearts dives you into a magical, alternate-timeline Victorian universe. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/f0a31dc435485e8779f11c695c4c5b879a69049d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Manipulate time [/h3]
Pause, fast-forward and rewind time using the Cuckoo Clock or Pocketwatch to change the outcomes of your actions or prevent danger from befalling the soldiers at all! This will help you in your goal to complete the increasingly intricate puzzles and guide the soldiers to safety. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/4ed6d7eb41c6ed60c36616713b8f4d4d7879f3af.png[/img]

[h3]Enjoy the memorable soundtrack [/h3]
Award-winning composer, Matthew Chastney, whose credits include trailers for ‘Joker’, ‘Chernobyl’, and ‘Bridgerton’ has created a moving soundtrack for Tin Hearts, with music to warm (and sometimes break) your heart. Take your time working through the relaxing puzzles, while listening to the poignant soundtrack. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/fc1d8346f04eead0eb5df12b75c13d56e8ef7acd.jpg[/img]

[h3]From the developers of Fable [/h3]
Brought to you by former members of the exceptionally talented Lionhead Studios team, responsible for the critically acclaimed Fable series. Keep an eye out for the hidden chickens throughout Tin Hearts, a subtle hint that the legacy of Fable flows throughout this game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/208c1d270b92593ff90a1bdc76641ba7808f1e26.png[/img]

Thank you for taking a look into the mechanics and features of Tin Hearts, but if you would like to go behind the scenes. Check out our making of Documentary series: [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL2oxQvg7jc1koNbqH_KcQZEokcxPzATzz]The Heart of It.[/url]

notes.title: Tin Hearts FAQ
notes.content:
We are excited that you have chosen to join us in this magical and whimsical world of Tin Hearts and want to make sure your tin soldiers are in tip-top form and ready to march.

Let's begin….

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/525da286c56609595e4b9c0b09ea0a23c493013d.png[/img]


[h3][b]What is Tin Hearts?[/b][/h3]
Guide a troop of tin soldiers through a beautiful, toy-filled world full of magic and mystery. Solve increasingly elaborate puzzles, forge new paths for your toys to follow and discover a deeply emotional story, in Tin Hearts - an immersive puzzle adventure game from members of the team that brought you Fable.

[h3][b]When is Tin Hearts launching?[/b][/h3]
Tin Hearts will be marching onto Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 & 5, and the Xbox family of consoles on April 20th, 2023.

[h3][b]Who developed Tin Hearts?[/b][/h3]
Rogue Sun was formed in May 2016 soon after the closure of historic UK-based Lionhead Studios. The founding team all worked on multiple Fable games together, and formed the studio out of a shared passion to create innovative, thoughtful and memorable gameplay experiences. Games with interesting mechanics, meaningful stories, beautiful aesthetics and multi-layered characters

[h3][b]Can I play Tin Hearts before launch?[/b][/h3]
Ahead of its release players can sign-up now for the [url=http://wired.gg/WiredBeta][b]closed PC beta[/b][/url], running from 10th - 14th February, 2023.  Experience the opening Act of Tin Hearts for the first time, guiding tin soldiers through a trail of puzzles using whimsical and inventive contraptions to bounce, shoot, and glide them to their goal. Join the [url=https://wired.gg/TinHeartsDiscord][b]Official Tin Hearts Discord[/b][/url], home to dedicated content with full access to speak directly with the developers, to find out more.

[h3][b]What is the price of Tin Hearts at Launch?[/b][/h3]
Tin Hearts will be  £ 24.99  / € 29.99  / $ 29.99.

[h3][b]What are the PC requirements?[/b][/h3]
System requirements can be found on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831700/Tin_Hearts/][b]Tin Hearts Steam Page.[/b][/url]

[h3][b]Will there be a physical edition?[/b][/h3]
There will be a Tin Hearts physical edition, complete with digital EP download and inventive stickers, for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch available via the[url=https://shop.wiredproductions.com/collections/tin-hearts] [b]Wired Productions Store.[/b][/url] You can reserve a copy today.

We look forward to you experiencing Tin Hearts

notes.title: Top 10 Games That Evoke the Christmas Spirit
notes.content:
Hello everyone! And thank you for checking out Tin Hearts - Those of you that have come over form the 'Prologue' original release, thank you for joining us again!

We can't wait to show you all of the exciting new updates we've been making and just how much the game has grown since our original development (and yes of course if you already owned what is now prologue, you don't pay a penny  - that would be rude of us!)

For everybody else, sit tight! We'll have lots of news and updates coming out in these blogs to keep you up to speed with what to expect with Tin Hearts soon enough!

We thought the news section looked a little bare however, and our publishers at Wired recently put out a fun little 'Christmas themed games' list! 

Tin Hearts VERY much evokes that magical time of the year feeling, with toys and trinkets and inventions aplenty - and a VERY family focused story, so we figured we'd share that list with you as we warm up to the festive period and start creating some Tin Hearts content to share.

Enjoy!

---------------------------

Winter is here. The snow is setting, carolers are singing, and soon Santa Claus will be coming to town! Of all of the amazing games we announced during this years Wired Direct, Tin Hearts is one that is sure to get players into the holiday mood.

Set in a magical toy-filled world, Tin Hearts will make you feel like a child in a toy shop again. The game harnesses the spirit of Christmas through its whimsical, warm nature, and deeply emotional, ‘Dickensian-like’ story, all wrapped perfectly together in a Victorian aesthetic. While we hope that Tin Hearts is on your WishList, as our present to you we have prepared a list of games that will get you into the festive spirit this Christmas time! And feel free to share your own suggestions with us!

[h3]10. BATMAN: ARKHAM ORIGINS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/1b28eda8b55b6b47caa6e059f5eb15f21e174ea7.jpg[/img]

Gotham is beautiful during the snowy Winter season, and you can experience it yourself by sitting down for a long evening in the now-classic Batman: Arkham Origins. Notably, the Arkham Origins incident in which Black mask puts a $50,000,000 bounty on Batman’s head takes place on Christmas Eve (which isn’t very Christmassy of him), so everywhere Batman goes, Christmas decorations inevitably follow.

Developer: Splash Damage, Warner Bros. Games Montreal
Platforms: PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Wii U, PC

[h3]9. YAKUZA 5[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/dde539bbb4ce2ff32e5fde149117e0dc492283aa.jpg[/img]

Yakuza 5 is set in December, so between the fighting and shooting, players have the opportunity to explore the cozy winter of Japan. Specifically, there is an entire section of the game dedicated to Christmas in which Saejima takes on a mission to stop a gang who have been beating up anyone dressed as Santa Claus. Inevitably, this ends up with Saejima needing to take on the role of Santa Claus himself and having to entertain children in the process… albeit, involuntarily.

Developer: Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio, Sega

Platforms: PlayStation 4, PlayStation 3, Xbox One, PC

[h3]8. WASTELAND 3[/h3]

Wasteland 3 claims to take place in a serious setting, but it is actually quite a funny and frivolous game. While exploring the winter wonderland world of a game, players can actually find Santa’s workshop. At first, the workshop may seem harmless – but, upon chatting with Santa and his elves, players will come to understand that there are some very deep and dark secrets kept here.

What is perhaps most interesting is the choice players can make in this situation – either leave everything as it is, free the elves, or subjugate the factory for yourself and profit from it! The latter may not seem very noble… but hey, in this post-apocalyptic world no one can tell you what to do!

Developer: inXile Entertainment

Platforms: PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PC

[h3]7.MARVEL’S SPIDER MAN: MILES MORALES[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/de9ac09b7497034b59b2831bfb89b03ea2dce6b2.jpg[/img]

The sequel to the action-adventure game Marvel’s Spider-Man, Marvel’s Spider-Man: Miles Morales takes place during the festive season while the original Spider-Man (Peter Parker) is away from New York. Of course, villains never sleep so the dream of a peaceful holiday season for our hero was never going to be a reality. Instead, in the midst of the action Miles gets to enjoyed the snow-covered, festively decorated, bustling scenes of New York City in the lead up to the holidays.

Developer: Insomniac Games

Platforms: PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5

[h3]6.ANIMAL CROSSING: NEW HORIZONS
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/d311be20732999cc1bc4672daa956938910eae53.jpg[/img]

In Animal Crossing, Toy Day is a huge holiday celebrated by the entire island. Throughout the month of December, the island begins to look more festive – the trees mysteriously acquire Christmas lights, villagers begin to decorate their homes and snow settles on the ground.

Jingle takes on the role of Santa Claus, the reindeer dressed in Santa’s attire will be found wondering around your island – requesting wrapping paper and providing recipes to do so. Throughout the Toy Day event, players will assist Jingle as he looks to fill the fellow villagers Toy Day stockings. All in all, the spirit of Christmas is guaranteed in Animal Crossing.

Developer: Nintendo

Platforms: Nintendo Switch

[h3]5.BULLY[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/d3289c6babec524aea0ced83b687c1420abd400b.jpg[/img]

Bully, or Canis Canem Edit in the PAL region, the action-adventure game developer by Rockstar Vancouver is not the typical game you would think of when it comes to Christmas. However, part of the game is dedicated to winter: the school is decorated with festive decorations, a Christmas performance is rehearsed in the assembly hall, and fully decorated Christmas trees can be found outside.

Yes, you still play as the juvenile delinquent Jimmy – so of course, you can let off some steam by throwing snowballs at as many passers by as you want.

Developer: Rockstar Vancouver

Platforms: PlayStation 2

[h3]4.MAFIA 2[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/5efe0ca76d30f610579d1674e15c9eea927dbd78.jpg[/img]

Mafia 2 is the game to play for those looking to find an unforgettable New Years and Winter atmosphere in video game format. From the very first few minutes of the story, players are thrown into the coldest of winters in a city full of narrow winding streets. Riding through the Winter streets is sure to put players in the right mood for this festive season.

Developer: Hangar 13 Czech

Platforms: PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PlayStation 3, PC

[h3]3. SANTA’S VILLAGE[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/8b26ec71bfe11812c5edced2b6b96d8f6ef023ac.jpg[/img]

Santa's Village is a management simulator with an isometric camera view for mobile platforms. Players take control of an entire village in which they must make sure that the elves are diligently prepare gifts, while Santa does not forget to separate the good children from the naughty ones. Set in a classic farm in the surroundings of the Christmas holidays, with 3D graphics, a funny plot and a pleasant setting, Santa’s Village is sure to put players straight into the Christmas spirit.

Developer: Making Fun, Inc.

Platforms: Mobile

[h3]2.The Fable Series[/h3]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/9c6a724e9e1f82819468a7b853f7268dc397e213.png[/img]

The Fable series has always felt like a Christmas game. Perhaps due to the release date always falling in late October – meaning most of us had to wait until Christmas before we could dive into the fictional continent of Albion again! This, combined with a magical atmosphere, adds an extra layer of immersion to the winter locations found throughout the Fable series such as Snowspire Village. Looking for a fairy tale like story, set in a rich environment? Welcome to Fable.

Developer: Lionhead Studios

Platforms: PC, Xbox, Xbox 360, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S

[h3]
1.Christmas Lemmings[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614831/889b942704c57d9097836b4e0c3256ca4a125d1c.png[/img]

Christmas Lemmings, also known as Holiday Lemmings, was released as part of a series of short games between 1991 and 1994. The gameplay remains unchanged from the base game, however – it comes with a festive Christmas twist!

Of course, Tin Hearts is a lemmings-style game, so we had to play homage to the forefather of the genre!

Developer: DMA Design

Platforms: DOS, Amiga

And there we have it! Our Top 10 Christmas Games which should, hopefully, evoke the Christmas Spirit – next year, you can even add Tin Hearts to this list!

If you haven’t seen it already, check out the latest Tin Hearts Trailer:

[previewyoutube=DAPaPsmGISs;full][/previewyoutube]

And in the spirit of giving… why not give Tin Hearts a Wishlist on Steam?

Wishing you all the best this Festive season, from the team at Rogue Sun and everyone at Wired - we'll see you soon!
